title: Paddle Billing API key (pdl_live_/pdl_sdbx_apikey_): one-property twin (length)
summary: 6 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value's length differs from the contracted length. Legacy mutation notes: length: a 2-character suffix vs exactly 3 (68 in all), length: a 21-character secret segment vs exactly 22, and length: a 23-character secret segment vs exactly 22, and 3 more. Twin of "Paddle Billing API key (pdl_live_/pdl_sdbx_apikey_): must be flagged (provider-documented) [legacy tier T1]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of paddle-api-key-bearer-header: length: a 23-character secret segment vs exactly 22. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
